content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-10. - Immunity from liability.
content.summary:
The city and its employees, the animal shelter and its employees, and any veterinarian
               consulted pursuant to this chapter shall be immune from liability for any actions
               taken pursuant to this chapter.
(Code 1981, § 6-10; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
